name: ZCA_ES_BATCHES
description: This table is used to store the ESS batch jobs

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Id of the batch, also the primary key

columns.name: ROOT_JOB_ID
columns.description: The request id of the root parent ESS job

columns.name: PARENT_JOB_ID
columns.description: The request id of the parent ESS job, if any

columns.name: ENTITY_UUID
columns.description: The Uuid of the entity belonging to the batch

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION
columns.description: The ESS job definition of the batch

columns.name: MAX_BUCKET
columns.description: The maximum batches required to process the ESS job

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: The bucket in which the batch job is to be processed

columns.name: PROCESSING_JOB_ID
columns.description: Ess job id if claimed for processing else null if unclaimed

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Null (not started), Success, SuccessOnRetry, Warning, Error

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: Time when processing was started for this batch

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: Time when processing was ended for this batch

columns.name: ERROR_WARNING_MESSAGE
columns.description: Short summary of error or warning for this batch

columns.name: ERROR_WARNING_DETAIL
columns.description:
Error or warning detail
including stack trace for bug diagnosis and triage for this batch

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
